dialogue.text: Hello!! Thank you for the first-aid! I want to go outside and play, but it is too dark. Can we play inside?

options.text: Before playing, can I ask you something?
What should I have in the case of an earthquake?

dialogue.text: Hmm.. Make sure you have a flashlight with some batteries just in case the power goes out! I always keep one with me.
You can use a portable radio to receive emergency information from the government.
Oh! Definitely have a first-aid kit with you just in case someone gets hurt! Or you play around too much with sharp objects... Learned that one the hard way...
Be careful too! After an earthquake there might be a gas leakage, so you definitely don't want to light any matches. I almost burned off my hair after the last earthquake.
